result:
Implementation complete. Summary of what was added:

- `src/schemas/issue-import.ts` — `importIssueRowSchema` / `importIssuesSchema` (new)
- `src/types/issue.ts` — `IssueImportResult`
- `src/types/event.ts` — `issues.imported` in `TaskflowEventMap`
- `src/types/activity.ts` — `issues.imported` added to `ActivityAction`
- `src/server/db/schema/issue-imports.ts` — `issue_import_batches` table (unique on `org_id, import_key`), wired into `schema/index.ts` and `migrate.ts`'s `SCHEMA_STATEMENTS`
- `src/server/repositories/issue-import-repository.ts` — `findImportBatch` (replay lookup) and `commitImport` (single SQLite transaction: create-once labels, numbered issues, join rows, replay record)
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts` — `findIssuesByIds` (order-preserving, for replay)
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` — `importIssues`: tenant scope → project lookup/archived/permission gates → replay short-circuit → plan quota check for the whole batch → rate-limit spend (one unit/row) → assignee resolution (active members only, case-insensitive) → atomic write → single `issues.imported` emit
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`, `usage-service.ts`, `search-service.ts` — each subscribes to `issues.imported` to produce the one audit row, bump the usage meter, and index every imported issue; `webhook-service.ts` and `notification-service.ts` were deliberately left untouched so imports never trigger webhooks or notifications
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` — added the missing `issues.imported` label (required by an existing exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>`)

`tsc --noEmit` is clean and the full `vitest run` suite (617 tests) passes. I also wrote and ran an ad-hoc smoke test (not committed) exercising numbering, label creation/reuse, assignee resolution, and replay semantics before deleting it.
